children: Middleby will discontinue its Brewing & Distilling Solutions Group, which generated $24 million in 2025 sales and a roughly $9 million adjusted EBITDA loss.
Announces discontinuation of Brewing & Distilling Solutions Group, including Deutsche Beverage + Process, Ss Brewtech and Wild Goose Filling.
Brewing Group represented $24M of 2025 net sales and ~ $9M adjusted EBITDA loss (about 60 bps negative to adjusted EBITDA margin).
Wind-down expected to be substantially complete by end of 2026; discontinuation deemed immaterial to 2026 guidance.
Company expects annual benefit to adjusted EBITDA margins to be realized in 2027.
Reiterates 2026 guidance: FY net sales $2.48–2.53B, adjusted EBITDA $572–588M, adjusted EPS $6.73–6.89.
This is an AI-powered summary. It may contain inaccuracies. Consider verifying important information with the source. Please note this summary is solely based on documents filed with the SEC.

title: Middleby to Wind Down Brewing Group after $24M 2025 Sales, Expects 2027 EBITDA Benefit
